university: Kuala Lumpur University of Science & Technology

fees.notes: Official IUKL (now KLUST) international fee schedule effective 26 Apr 2022, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20220627135640id_/https://iukl.edu.my/iukl-application-forms/Undergraduate-International-fee-structure.pdf?v=20220513: tuition RM12,600 total for Foundation in Arts (1 year, RM4,200/semester; 1st semester RM12,240, subsequent RM4,440); approximate all-in programme fee RM21,120. Current KLUST site (checked 2026-09-18) no longer publishes programme fees ('Ask us').

requirements.general: Any one of these: SPM: Minimum 5Cs (including Mathematics/Accounting). O-Level: Minimum 5Cs (including Mathematics/Accounting). UEC: Minimum 4Bs (including Mathematics/Accounting). Other Qualifications: As recognised by the Senate of IUKL as equivalent to SPM.
